desc: Leave works mid-run, in the mode's battle: a refight of Lord Crump with the mid-game loadout lent (TTYD_MODE_TEST=refight:0:1; no auto-battler, so the battle waits at its command menu), left 1800 frames into the run as the Settings tab's button does (TTYD_MODERUN_LEAVE): the battle ends as run away, the refight stops (no win, no Rematch), the lent loadout goes back and Mario is back in Rogueport where he stood; control back with nothing lent and the file's stats, partners, badges, items, key items, coins, Star Points and story exactly as before
log_must: \[modes\] leave: the battle ends as run away
\[modes\] refight stopped at step 1: back to gor_01
\[moderun\] check after Boss refights: stats same, partners same, badges same, items same, key items same, coins (\d+) -> \1, star points (\d+) -> \2, story same
log_must_not: \[modes\] map gor_m0: battle[\s\S]*\[modes\] map gor_m0: battle
